body: Create an animation-ready modular 2D cel shaded fantasy game cutout atlas, Arcane Vanguard style, bold clean dark outlines, painterly cel shading, detailed but readable at small size. Landscape high-resolution image on TRUE transparent alpha. SIX separate equally sized panels arranged THREE columns TWO rows. View directions reading order: E right profile, SE front-right threequarter, SW front-left threequarter, W left profile, NW rear-left threequarter, NE rear-right threequarter. Rear views show BACK of skull/hair, BACK of clothing, no face or front chest ornament. Every panel contains exactly12 ISOLATED BODY PIECES in3columns4rows, consistent local ordering: row1 head, upper torso from neck to waist ONLY, rear cape; row2 pelvis/skirt, anatomical left upperarm, right upperarm; row3 left forearm including hand, right forearm including hand, left leg without foot; row4 right leg without foot, left boot, right boot. No full figures. Head entirely detached from torso. Arms split at elbows. Legs stop at ankles. NO equipment or effects in body sheet. Large transparent gutters between every cutout and everypanel. Avoid labels, checkerboard, background, panels, borders. Do not connect pieces. Full consistent identity across six genuine rotations. Subject: Banshee Queen ghost, pale spectral feminine face with open dark mouth, long white hair and small silver crown, flowing tattered mint white gown, long detached white sleeves and translucent gray green cloth. Ghostly queen, no armor. Leg and boot slots are separate floating robe-tails, NOT physical boots. CRITICAL use THREEcolumns TWOrows of six directional panels, NOT six columns. Every panel3columns4rows of twelve distinctparts; total9columns8rows of pieces. Headonly; torsowithoutarms; cape; pelvis; TWOupperarms; TWOforearmswithhands; TWOhanginglowerrobes replacinglegs; TWOsmallerclothends replacingboots. Transparentlargegutters.
equipment: Equipment-only cutout atlas. SIX isolated small silver SCEPTERS, no people, no faces, no ghosts, no robes, no hands. True transparent background. 3 columns2 rows: rightprofile,front-right,front-left,leftprofile,rear-left,rear-right. Every cell contains ONLY one short silver metal royal scepter with pale mint faceted gemstone at top. Full shaft visible. Painterly cel shaded fantasy game equipment with crisp dark outline. No haze or glow background. No text. Six small props only.
effects: Transparent 2D hand-painted cel shaded fantasy GAME VFX SPRITESHEET. Exactly8columns4rows,32 individual animation frames. Each row one8frame left-to-right animation. Large transparent gutters between frames and rows. All cells same size, effect centered, frame0 small beginning then development then frame7 almost vanished. Absolutely no background haze rectangles, no whole-sheet mist, no text or grid, alpha outside individual effects ZERO. Arcane Vanguard boldclean shapes with subtle limited glow. ROW1: Wail: mint spectral sonic crescent expands outward from small point with wispy trailing rings, fades. ROW2: Wail echo: circular mint ghost shockwave expands with wispy screaming face motif, then fades. ROW3: White mint ghost breath gathers into small halo then fades. ROW4: Ghost queen summoning: white mint wisps coalesce then disperse. No characters or weapons.
